doc: Cloud objects of a patch: mask = patch > 0.5 (strict), scipy.ndimage.label with its default structure, 4-CONNECTIVITY (edge neighbours only: two texels that touch diagonally are two objects; no wraparound), area = texel count * patch_px_km^2 (77.0252 km^2 per texel); returns (share of the cloudy area held by objects larger than 1e5 km^2, median object area in km^2), and (0.0, 0.0) when there is no object. A real patch crop (128x128, rows and columns 64..191 of the 256x256 patch at latitude 55, longitude 0 of the Earth map at 1024x512), stored as float32 and called on its float64 promotion; no texel equals 0.5. Diagnostics recomputed by the case through the same label call, not returned by the function: n_objects and areas_km2 (in ndimage.label order: by the raster position of each object's first texel); a port's labelling must produce the same multiset of areas. Integer counts times a float64 constant: exact up to the rounding of a product and a sum, 1e-9.

params.called_with: float64 promotion of the stored float32 patch
